psychological_meaning: Green is strongly associated with nature, growth, and renewal. It often represents balance, harmony, and stability. Emotionally, green can evoke feelings of peace, tranquility, and hope. It is also connected to health, prosperity, and generosity, signifying abundance and well-being.
